verdict.rationale: Helicone documents its own instrumentation path: a proxy/gateway that apps reach through the existing OpenAI SDK by changing a couple of lines, with one-line logging claimed for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini and the Vercel AI SDK (a JS/TS integration). The evidence never names a first-party Helicone SDK, and it never states which languages are supported, so dual Python and JS/TS coverage is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of official Helicone-maintained Python and JS/TS SDKs, explicit Python support documentation, and independent corroboration of instrumentation in both languages.
